title: Standards candidates are mined from AGENTS.md bullets that recur in at least two operator repositories
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114c #5. standards/records.json has 26 records and none for PHP, WordPress or frontend; .krn/adopted.json is absent, so krn standards harvest sees nothing.
Outcome: a harvest mode that reads the instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) of named repositories and proposes a standard candidate for each normalized bullet recurring in two or more of them, with source paths; candidates are reviewed into records, never auto-accepted.
Proof: fixture test with three synthetic repositories; npm run fast PASS.
